title: Quick Mexican Pilaf
description: A flavorful Mexican-inspired pilaf dish made with a variety of ingredients. Cook in under 30 minutes!
instructions: Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the diced pepper and cook for 3-4 minutes until tender.
Add the cooked pilaf and stir to combine with the pepper.
Add the sliced Russian sausage and cooked ground beef.
Sprinkle the Mexican seasoning over the top and stir to combine.
Transfer the mixture to a baking dish and top with shredded cheese.
Bake in a preheated oven at 375°F (190°C) for 5-7 minutes until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
